import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "src"); sys.path.insert(0, ".")
sys.platform = "darwin"
from brainlayer.hotlane_budget import HotlaneCpuSampler
from scripts import hotlane_cpu_ratchet as r
d = Path(sys.argv[1]); d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
clock, cpu = [0.0], [0.0]
s = HotlaneCpuSampler(d / "x.db", clock=lambda: clock[0], cpu_clock=lambda: cpu[0])
for t in range(1, 600):          # sustained load > ceiling, 1 s cycles
    clock[0] = t; cpu[0] += 0.05; s.observe("high load")
clock[0] = 600; cpu[0] += 2; s.observe("running", 16)   # the 300 s minimum-duty batch
print("read in the ~1 s after a min-duty batch ->", r.read_report(s.path))
clock[0] = 601; cpu[0] += 0.05; s.observe("high load")
print("next cycle ->", r.read_report(s.path))
